headline: Anduril now says its BlueChip laptop will meet Buy American standards at launch
summary: Anduril and Qualcomm partner to build US-made laptops. Their BlueChip laptop aims for Buy American standards by 2027. Goal is a fully domestic computer supply chain.

headline: Adam Mosseri says negativity around AI is ‘going to get worse’
summary: Instagram head Adam Mosseri acknowledges growing AI negativity. He notes dislike extends beyond young people and creatives. Mosseri expects the negative sentiment to intensify.

headline: A hacker stole more than 40,000 DHS employee records
summary: A hacker breached DHS systems, stealing 41,000+ employee records. Exposed data includes names, job titles, contacts, and office locations. ICE and CBP personnel information was compromised.

headline: Akai is embracing vibe-coded mods with an open-source MPC
summary: Akai is showing off modding community work for its unannounced MPC Sample Key. The device will feature open-source firmware, encouraging customization. Akai embraces hackers by providing early device access.

headline: Upgrade to OLED Gaming With the Entry-Level Gigabyte GO27Q24A Monitor
summary: Elevate your gaming with the new Gigabyte GO27Q24A monitor. Experience stunning visuals thanks to OLED technology. An accessible entry point for premium gaming displays.

headline: A Famous GTA 4 Meme Is Now a Mechanic in GTA 6
summary: GTA 6 incorporates a popular GTA 4 meme into its gameplay. A beloved meme has been transformed into a new game mechanic. Fans will recognize the nod to past entries.

headline: GTA 6's Map Will Open Up Relatively Early and Let You Explore Freely, Developers Are Still Discovering New Parts of the World
summary: GTA 6 map will be largely accessible early in the game. Rockstar confirms no story progression blocks for exploration. Developers are still finding new areas within the vast world.

headline: BioWare Co-Founder Speaks Out on Studio Closure, Mass Effect Cancellation
summary: BioWare co-founder Greg Zeschuk addresses recent studio closure. 50 jobs were lost, part of 400 company-wide cuts. Mass Effect 5, titled 'Universe,' was confirmed cancelled.

headline: Healey promises reduction in welfare bill before next election
summary: Chancellor Healey pledges to cut the welfare bill. The reduction is promised before the next general election. Conservatives criticized the Budget for lacking welfare reform details.

headline: I earn £30,000. I'm angry there was no fuel duty cut in the Budget
summary: Public expresses anger over the recent Budget decisions. Many earners, including those on £30,000, are disappointed. No fuel duty cut was a key point of contention.

headline: Spain begins three days of mourning after train crash kills dozens
summary: Spain declares three days of national mourning. Dozens died in one of Europe's worst modern rail disasters. Emergency teams worked overnight to find victims.

headline: Ofcom outlines ways social media can verify ages of users
summary: Ofcom proposes methods for social media age verification. Options include photo ID, digital ID, or banking checks. Facial age estimation is also suggested for users 16 or over.
